keys.swarm.aura_swift_strikes_desc: When the skill is ready, a sharp turn makes you dash through and slash what is in the way, ending with an X-cut.
keys.swarm.aura_swift_strikes_up: Longer dashes, faster reset; a second cut from level 5.
keys.swarm.aura_swift_strikes_ten: Blur: after-images stay behind and keep slashing.
keys.swarm.aura_night_sickles_desc: A sickle buries itself in a monster and keeps cutting it; when that monster dies (or after 3 seconds) it springs to the next nearest one.
keys.swarm.aura_night_sickles_ten: Harvest Moon: each spring cuts a crescent through everything on its path.
